[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
William was born before 1787.
== Research Notes ==
The birth bound before 1787 is a working profile estimate; the cited FamilySearch source list has not independently established it in this review. His recorded family includes wife [[Denham-2159|Ann Denham]] and daughter [[Glasgow-3544|Agnes Glasgow]], with a Manchester marriage recorded in the held profile context. These connections support comparison with later Manchester records but do not themselves identify the deceased man below.

=== Manchester death notice and register comparisons ===

An original newspaper notice reports that William Glasgow, ironfounder and engineer, died on 5 April 1848 at his residence in Great Bridgewater-street, Manchester, aged 66. It appeared on 12 April; that publication day is not his death day.<ref name="Manchester1848">''Manchester Courier and Lancashire General Advertiser'', 12 April 1848, Deaths, column 1, printed page 240 (viewer page 6), [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/image-viewer?issue=BL%2F0000206%2F18480412&page=0006&article=049&stringtohighlight=william+glasgow William Glasgow notice]. Original printed page inspected 4 November 2026. The notice reports death on 5 April, aged 66, at his residence in Great Bridgewater-street, Manchester, describing him as an ironfounder and engineer. The [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_104260820296 derivative index R_104260820296] repeats the publication date as death date; the original gives the fifth.</ref> No wife or parent is named. This William is a compatible candidate for the present profile, but no independent occupation or address evidence connects the known family to the ironfounder. His age implies birth about 1782; this is an age-derived estimate, not an exact birth record or a replacement for the existing birth bound.

Two All Saints, Chorlton upon Medlock, burial indexes describe William Glasgow aged 64 in 1848. Their generic Date fields read 5 April and 8 April; the first also names spouse Ann Glasgow.<ref name="ManchesterBurials1848">Findmypast, ''England, Greater Manchester Burials 1570-1990'', [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_102734966661 R_102734966661] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_102734948331 R_102734948331], William Glasgow, male, aged 64, Chorlton upon Medlock, All Saints, Manchester, 1848. The generic Date fields are 5 April and 8 April respectively; only the first names spouse Ann Glasgow. Derivative transcripts inspected 4 November 2026; original register not inspected.</ref> These may concern the same man as the notice, with one date representing death and another burial, but the uninspected register is needed to test that interpretation. The reported ages 64 and 66 differ. The records are not established independent witnesses or proved duplicates. Neither date is assigned here as his burial, and no death is assigned to this profile.

The recorded spouse Ann is compatible with [[Denham-2159|Ann Denham]], but the index gives only her married surname and no evidence of her own death. The original newspaper names no spouse. The existing family links and their evidence grades remain unchanged. The next useful checks are the original register entries and independent evidence of William's occupation or Great Bridgewater-street residence.
